title: ResearchEvidence v1
description: A domain-neutral evidence record binding producer, inputs, content hash, applicability, evidence level, and limitations. Evidence states only which claims it directly supports; file existence or a zero exit code never upgrades its level.

claim_ids.description: Claims this evidence directly supports. Cross-record consistency is checked by graph verification, not here.

model.description: Optional model identifier when a model produced the artifact.

locator.description: Optional safe relative path to the input. Absolute paths, UNC, drive letters, and '..' are rejected.

inputs.description: Inputs the evidence binds: code, config, data, case, environment, or runner identifiers.

content_sha256.description: Hash of the evidence content itself. The hash is authoritative; any locator is secondary.

content_locator.description: Optional safe relative path to the content. Absolute paths, UNC, drive letters, and '..' are rejected.

applicability.description: Scope within which this evidence applies.

evidence_level.description: Free-form level label. The core never enumerates or upgrades levels; each domain adapter constrains its own ladder.

limitations.description: Known limitations of this evidence. Required; may be an explicit empty array.
